newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vitol makes best offer to Sri Lanka diesel tender.
newsitem.headline: Vitol makes best offer to Sri Lanka diesel tender.

text.p: The lowest offer in Sri Lanka's tender to buy diesel and jet fuel was made by Dutch trader Vitol for June 1-2 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo, a source with state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Thursday.
The 250,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil was offered at a 14-cent-per-barrel discount to Singapore spot quotes, and the 50,000 barrels of jet fuel were offered at a 5-cent discount.
The tender, which closed on May 14, received seven offers. It would be awarded on Friday, the source said.

In its last tender, CPC bought from Glencore 230,000 barrels of diesel at 38 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes and 40,000 barrels of 95-octane leaded gasoline at a 38-cent premium for May 21-22 delicery, c-and-f Colombo.
